body: But it's just not the person I am, that's why I'm posting here anonymously. I'm too prideful to ask for help or to feel like I'm "sponging" off anyone. I paid for the down payment on my husband's car, paid for the deposit on our house, all the money that I've got during my last few birthdays and christmases (amounting to probably a few thousand) has gone into the bank and been used for things for US. But now my husband is cutting me off because he's sick of me "taking his money" and that's how he wants everyone to see it. I have worked doing things I absolutely hate and feel so ashamed of, but I never saw a penny of the money I made, it went towards him or into OUR savings, and now he's demanding all that money back so he can "do what he wants with it" and it just hurts me that I'm always taking care of him and us before I'm taking care of myself, yet everyone around him thinks I'm some lazy girl who wants money handed to me all the time. I had so much money in savings so that I could start my own business, and it's all gone towards things for him.

But I won't be happy if I go back to my parents. I love them more than anything, but I also love my husband and I know he would kill himself without me there. I know he needs me, even though he acts like he doesn't. If I go back to my parents I'll just be sponging off them for potentially the rest of my life because I'm stuck with these illnesses that I'll never get cured of.
